BiblicalUsage: To deliver in Daniel is the work no other god can do. Nebuchadnezzar decrees that no other God can deliver after this sort, Darius labours till sunset to deliver Daniel from the lions' den, and Darius himself confesses that God delivers and rescues, working signs and wonders in heaven and on earth.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe deliverance is God's signature: kings labour and fail at it, but the God of Daniel delivers from the furnace and from the lions alike. Darius laboured till sunset to save Daniel and failed, and the next morning he confessed the God who delivers.
